OUR LITTLE CLASSROOMS

Science Lab

Ask a question. Follow your curiosity.

Grow a bean

Ages 6–1220 min + daily check-ins

Watch roots and shoots appear, then draw the changes in your own bean diary.

Sink or Float?

Ages 4–720–30 minutes

Test everyday objects in water, record what happens and redesign a foil boat.

My Weather Journal

Ages 4–75–10 minutes a day

Observe the sky, keep a weather diary, choose an outfit and build a toy shelter.

Shadow detectives

Ages 3–815 min

Torch in hand, children make shadows grow and shrink, turn them into creatures, predict their shapes and trace them like real evidence.
